## Selected projects

- [MedBlink](https://github.com/RAZERBOY786/MEDBLINK): three-app healthcare and
  medicine-delivery ecosystem (customer, warehouse, rider) with one shared
  Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend.
- [Smart Data Analyzer](https://github.com/RAZERBOY786/Smart-Data-Analyzer):
  React Native + Flask app that runs end-to-end data analysis and ML workflows
  on a phone.
- [Gitview](https://github.com/RAZERBOY786/Gitview): mobile GitHub analytics
  dashboard for activity, repository insights and contribution trends.
- [SkyPure](https://github.com/RAZERBOY786/SKYPURE): air-quality-index
  prediction app combining React Native with a Python deep-learning model.
- [Plant Disease Detection](https://github.com/RAZERBOY786/leafwish): CNN image
  classifier (TensorFlow transfer learning + OpenCV) detecting 20+ plant
  diseases at ~92% accuracy.
